name: Semiconductor Cleanroom Control
mechanism: Control measured particulate and chemical contamination around qualified semiconductor processes
operating_requirement: Filtered process environment, suitable water and gases, trained staff and monitoring
consequence: Reduce contamination-related yield losses at continuing utility and maintenance cost

name: Semiconductor Thermal Diffusion
mechanism: Control dopant redistribution through a qualified thermal process and measured profiles
operating_requirement: Suitable wafers, characterized dopant sources, thermal equipment and process metrology
consequence: Form specified doped regions with finite process tolerances

name: Ion Implantation Control
mechanism: Introduce selected ions into a substrate under controlled beam and dose conditions
operating_requirement: Qualified implantation equipment, source materials, vacuum, power and profile measurement
consequence: Produce controlled dopant distributions with damage and uniformity limits

name: Implant Damage Annealing
mechanism: Recover selected implantation damage and activate dopants through evaluated thermal treatment
operating_requirement: Qualified thermal system, process windows and electrical or structural measurements
consequence: Improve specified device properties without erasing diffusion and stress constraints

name: Selective Wet Etching
mechanism: Remove selected exposed material using qualified chemical selectivity and endpoint evidence
operating_requirement: Compatible process chemistry, masking, handling systems and effluent treatment
consequence: Transfer selected structures while undercut and material compatibility limit geometry

name: Plasma Pattern Etching
mechanism: Control plasma-assisted material removal to produce evaluated patterned geometry
operating_requirement: Qualified plasma tool, process gases, vacuum, power and inspection
consequence: Support selected anisotropic features with finite damage and selectivity limits

name: Chemical Mechanical Planarization
mechanism: Combine controlled surface chemistry and polishing to reduce measured topography
operating_requirement: Qualified slurries, pads, equipment, cleaning and surface metrology
consequence: Prepare sufficiently level surfaces for later fabrication while consuming materials

name: Wafer Alignment Metrology
mechanism: Measure positional correspondence between patterned layers against alignment references
operating_requirement: Calibrated optics, reference marks and qualified positioning
consequence: Bound overlay errors rather than assuming successive layers coincide

name: Wafer Electrical Probing
mechanism: Measure selected device behavior before separating wafer dies
operating_requirement: Qualified probe interfaces, test equipment, power and reference criteria
consequence: Identify usable dies and process faults without guaranteeing packaged reliability

name: Die Separation Control
mechanism: Separate processed dies while limiting edge damage and contamination
operating_requirement: Qualified separation tools, handling, cleaning and inspection
consequence: Recover finite usable dies from a wafer with measured losses

name: Wire Bond Interconnection
mechanism: Form qualified fine-wire electrical connections between die and package contacts
operating_requirement: Suitable wire, bond equipment, clean interfaces and pull or electrical checks
consequence: Connect compatible dies within current, geometry and reliability limits

name: Flip Chip Interconnection
mechanism: Join aligned die contacts directly to a compatible carrier through qualified interconnects
operating_requirement: Matched surfaces, bonding materials, positioning and inspection
consequence: Support dense short package connections with thermal and fatigue constraints

name: Through Silicon Interconnects
mechanism: Form insulated conductive paths through a semiconductor substrate
operating_requirement: Qualified deep-feature processes, insulation, fill materials and defect inspection
consequence: Support selected vertical connections with electrical and mechanical limits

name: Wafer Bonding Integration
mechanism: Join prepared wafer surfaces under qualified interface and alignment conditions
operating_requirement: Clean planar surfaces, controlled bonding and interface inspection
consequence: Integrate compatible structures while bond defects constrain yield

name: Chiplet Interface Design
mechanism: Specify interoperable electrical, timing and transaction behavior among packaged compute dies
operating_requirement: Compatible dies, substrate, qualification evidence and maintained interface specifications
consequence: Compose selected functions without assuming any chip can connect to any other

name: Three Dimensional Die Stacking
mechanism: Integrate vertically connected active dies with evaluated thermal and test access
operating_requirement: Known-good dies, bonding equipment, power delivery and heat removal
consequence: Increase selected integration density while heat and compounded yield remain costs

name: Package Thermal Path Design
mechanism: Design and measure heat flow from active devices through package interfaces
operating_requirement: Qualified interface materials, mechanical assembly and thermal testing
consequence: Keep operating components within evaluated temperature envelopes

name: Semiconductor Reliability Stress Tests
mechanism: Relate selected accelerated stress observations to bounded device-failure models
operating_requirement: Characterized samples, controlled stress equipment and failure analysis
consequence: Estimate reliability limits without equating short tests with unlimited lifetime

name: Electronic Static Discharge Control
mechanism: Limit uncontrolled charge transfer during qualified component handling
operating_requirement: Grounded handling systems, suitable packaging, monitoring and trained workers
consequence: Reduce handling damage without making devices immune to every surge

name: Boundary Scan Testing
mechanism: Use accessible test chains to inspect selected board interconnections and device states
operating_requirement: Compatible test logic, documented access, equipment and test vectors
consequence: Find supported assembly faults where physical probing is impractical

name: Pipeline Instruction Execution
mechanism: Overlap defined instruction-processing stages while managing hazards
operating_requirement: Implemented processor, clocking, control circuitry and verified instruction behavior
consequence: Improve selected throughput while hazards and stalls consume cycles

name: Branch Prediction Models
mechanism: Predict likely instruction-control paths from retained execution evidence
operating_requirement: Predictor state, processor control and measured workloads
consequence: Reduce some control stalls while mispredictions incur real wasted work

name: Out Of Order Execution
mechanism: Schedule ready operations while preserving architecturally required effects
operating_requirement: Dependency tracking, reorder resources and verified exception handling
consequence: Exploit selected execution parallelism at area, power and validation cost

name: Vector Instruction Execution
mechanism: Apply a defined operation across multiple data elements with explicit lane behavior
operating_requirement: Compatible execution lanes, memory bandwidth and suitable compiled programs
consequence: Accelerate suitable data-parallel work rather than arbitrary programs

name: Cache Coherence Protocols
mechanism: Maintain specified shared-memory visibility among cached processor copies
operating_requirement: Compatible interconnects, protocol state and verified ordering rules
consequence: Support shared parallel programs with coherence traffic and contention costs

name: Hardware Interrupt Handling
mechanism: Transfer execution to defined event handlers while preserving required machine state
operating_requirement: Compatible control hardware, handler software and bounded event sources
consequence: Respond to peripheral events without continuous polling of every device

name: Direct Memory Transfer
mechanism: Move bounded data between devices and memory through controlled transfer engines
operating_requirement: Compatible bus hardware, address controls and driver coordination
consequence: Reduce processor copying work while consuming memory and interconnect bandwidth

name: Programmable Logic Arrays
mechanism: Configure a qualified array of logic and routing resources to implement specified circuits
operating_requirement: Programmable device, configuration tools, power and verified design
consequence: Reconfigure selected hardware functions within finite device capacity

name: Electronic Design Synthesis
mechanism: Translate a circuit description into a constrained implementation and assess equivalence
operating_requirement: Design tools, target library, computation and engineering review
consequence: Reduce some circuit-development work without eliminating physical qualification

name: Hardware Timing Closure
mechanism: Check and revise implemented signal paths against specified timing constraints
operating_requirement: Characterized device and interconnect models, analysis tools and measured validation
consequence: Establish bounded timing margins rather than relying on logical correctness alone

name: Operating System Device Drivers
mechanism: Mediate specified device operations through controlled software interfaces
operating_requirement: Documented hardware, driver code, compatible operating system and test access
consequence: Allow applications to use actual peripherals under access and failure rules

name: Virtual Machine Monitors
mechanism: Control guest execution and privileged resource access over shared physical hardware
operating_requirement: Compatible processor support or software translation, monitor code and verification
consequence: Host isolated guests while sharing finite compute and memory

name: Checkpoint Restart Computation
mechanism: Persist sufficient job state to resume after a supported interruption
operating_requirement: Durable storage, consistent checkpoint logic and spare execution capacity
consequence: Recover completed work within checkpoint scope while paying storage and pause overhead

name: Write Ahead Recovery Logs
mechanism: Record intended persistent changes before applying recoverable data updates
operating_requirement: Ordered durable writes, log storage and tested recovery code
consequence: Restore defined transaction consistency after supported failures

name: Multiversion Concurrency Control
mechanism: Retain record versions so compatible transactions can observe defined snapshots
operating_requirement: Version storage, visibility rules and reclamation work
consequence: Permit selected concurrent reads and writes with storage and conflict costs

name: Query Cost Optimization
mechanism: Compare alternative execution plans using measured data and resource estimates
operating_requirement: Statistics, optimizer computation and available access paths
consequence: Reduce some query work while stale estimates can select poor plans

name: Distributed Job Partitioning
mechanism: Divide a computation into communicating tasks under measured dependency and data constraints
operating_requirement: Available workers, actual network service and coordination software
consequence: Use several machines when coordination costs do not dominate

name: Replicated Service Failover
mechanism: Transfer service responsibility to a qualified replica while controlling conflicting ownership
operating_requirement: Independent reachable replicas, state replication and tested takeover rules
consequence: Restore supported services with finite interruption and consistency limits

name: Content Integrity Hashing
mechanism: Compute a specified content digest with declared collision and adversary assumptions
operating_requirement: Qualified implementation, finite compute and reference checks
consequence: Compare content integrity without proving authorship or truth

name: Credential Revocation Distribution
mechanism: Distribute and evaluate current invalidation of previously issued credentials
operating_requirement: Reachable update sources, freshness rules and maintained trust anchors
consequence: Limit continued use of invalid credentials while offline clients retain uncertainty

name: Least Privilege Capability Systems
mechanism: Represent and delegate narrowly scoped authority through controlled capabilities
operating_requirement: Compatible enforcement, accountable grants and revocation mechanisms
consequence: Restrict authorized actions without assuming credentials imply unlimited permission

name: Verified Boot Chains
mechanism: Check successive executable stages against an established trust policy before use
operating_requirement: Protected trust anchors, compatible hardware and recovery provisions
consequence: Detect specified unauthorized startup changes while trust-root compromise remains relevant

name: Reproducible Software Builds
mechanism: Recreate specified binary outputs from controlled source and build inputs
operating_requirement: Recorded toolchain, deterministic process and independent compute
consequence: Compare distributed software with declared build inputs without proving source safety

name: Software Dependency Provenance
mechanism: Track source, version and composition of incorporated software components
operating_requirement: Maintained manifests, identifiable artifacts and accountable review
consequence: Locate affected dependencies when defects or trust changes are discovered

name: Service Resource Quotas
mechanism: Enforce declared per-consumer resource limits and allocation priorities
operating_requirement: Measured compute/storage use, enforcement software and service operators
consequence: Prevent one admitted workload from consuming all shared capacity by policy accident

name: Compute Power Budgeting
mechanism: Schedule workloads against measured electrical capacity and performance-energy profiles
operating_requirement: Working power meters, controllable workloads and dispatch coordination
consequence: Trade turnaround time against finite supplied electrical power

name: Server Airflow Management
mechanism: Separate and route cooling air according to measured server heat loads and pressure paths
operating_requirement: Fans, contained air paths, sensors, power and maintenance
consequence: Remove supported heat loads without treating room volume as cooling capacity

name: Liquid Cooled Compute Racks
mechanism: Move server heat through qualified liquid interfaces and heat-exchange loops
operating_requirement: Compatible cold plates, pumps, coolant, leak monitoring and heat rejection
consequence: Support evaluated rack heat loads with pumping and cooling overhead

name: Compute Water Energy Accounting
mechanism: Measure direct water and electrical demands against delivered computing service
operating_requirement: Metered facility boundaries, workload records and maintained instruments
consequence: Expose local resource tradeoffs rather than claiming efficient chips make a resource-free service

name: Accelerator Workload Mapping
mechanism: Map eligible operations and data movement onto specialized execution resources
operating_requirement: Compatible accelerator, software support, memory and actual workload
consequence: Accelerate suitable tasks while transfer and idle costs remain

name: Training Data Lineage
mechanism: Track origin, transformations and allowed use of data entering a learning process
operating_requirement: Maintained records, accessible source evidence and responsible data stewardship
consequence: Enable review and correction of training inputs without asserting source truth

name: Held Out Model Evaluation
mechanism: Estimate task performance on appropriately separated data with leakage checks
operating_requirement: Representative evaluation data, defined metrics and independent analysis
consequence: Expose generalization limits rather than rewarding training-set fit

name: Model Uncertainty Calibration
mechanism: Compare predictive confidence with observed outcomes under evaluated conditions
operating_requirement: Applicable observations, calibration methods and continuing review
consequence: Make reported uncertainty more informative within its evidence domain

name: Model Compression Qualification
mechanism: Reduce model representation or computation while measuring retained task performance
operating_requirement: Source model, compression tools, finite compute and representative tests
consequence: Trade memory and speed against measured loss rather than promise free efficiency

name: Federated Model Training
mechanism: Coordinate model updates across separate data holders under explicit disclosure assumptions
operating_requirement: Willing participants, local compute, actual communication and reviewed aggregation
consequence: Train selected models without assuming raw data centralization or automatic privacy

name: Machine Action Runtime Monitors
mechanism: Check specified operating constraints during machine execution and trigger bounded fallback
operating_requirement: Independent-enough observations, enforceable intervention and maintained monitor logic
consequence: Stop or constrain detected violations within monitored scope

name: Robotic Contact Force Control
mechanism: Regulate measured interaction forces during qualified machine contact tasks
operating_requirement: Force-capable sensors, compliant or controlled actuators, power and task qualification
consequence: Perform selected contact work within force, bandwidth and environment limits

name: Robotic Self Localization Maps
mechanism: Estimate machine pose and environmental landmarks from uncertain observations
operating_requirement: Suitable sensors, computation and observable reference features
consequence: Navigate within estimated confidence while ambiguity can stop progress

name: Robotic Tool Change Qualification
mechanism: Verify mounted-tool identity, geometry and service connections before executing a task
operating_requirement: Compatible couplers, calibrated tools, inspection and maintained control records
consequence: Reuse a machine across qualified tasks without assuming every tool is interchangeable

name: Quantum Device Noise Characterization
mechanism: Estimate specified operation and measurement errors under characterized test conditions
operating_requirement: Working quantum device, calibrated control, repeated measurements and analysis
consequence: Bound noise evidence for later error management without claiming useful computation from qubit count
